scope: Independent actual-pixel critique of authored raster eight-direction concept sheets. Not an editable 3D, native gameplay, animation, economy, device or reference-video approval.
threshold: Pass strictly above 9.0 and every mandatory scoped check passed. No score averaging.

defects.observation: The rear-left 225 degree panel has its square end at the left and long axis rising to the right, matching 135/315. For this front-long-face symmetric bar, 225 must have the opposite diagonal, matching the 45 degree geometric projection.
defects.repair: Regenerate the 225 degree view with the long face on the left and left-end square face on the right, long axis descending to the right.

defects.observation: Large polygonal fracture-like facets over the broad faces and warm bronze bevels make this read as a carved dark stone block. Its rectangular shape differentiates it from the existing recessed-top steel ingot, but the iron material is insufficiently clear.
defects.repair: Use continuous dark iron satin faces, smaller subtle forged surface marks, and restrained cool metallic highlights, retaining the long square-section forged bar.

defects.observation: Title and angle labels use a prominent serif face unlike the established modern sans treatment and the neighboring new sheets.
defects.repair: Use the same bold sans-serif ivory type treatment as the set.

positive_observations: One bar in every cell; no count drift.
Readable labels and full object framing.
Proportions and identity are visually distinct from existing squat polished steel ingot.

defects.observation: Rear-left 225 degrees repeats the rising-right diagonal of rear-right 135/front-left 315. With the same unmarked rectangular plate, its geometry should match the descending-right diagonal of 45 degrees instead.
defects.repair: Regenerate only the 225 degree object with the correct opposite diagonal while preserving the flat thin single-panel design, material and label.

positive_observations: All views show one coherent thin sheet, not a thick slab or stack.
Brushed silver material reads clearly as processed metal.
Full silhouette and clean labels, all eight cells present.

defects.observation: Rear-left 225 degrees shows its face aimed the same direction as rear-right 135/front-left 315, instead of the opposite 45-degree projection for the symmetrically faced gear.
defects.repair: Correct the 225 degree projection to the 45 degree geometric direction, preserving the opposite rear face and matching symmetric construction.

defects.observation: Front and rear panels both show a projecting central hub, but right 90 degrees shows a left-only hub and left 270 degrees a right-only hub. At a true edge view both opposite-face hub extensions must be visible; this is not ordinary occlusion.
defects.repair: Render both 90 and 270 profiles with matching hub extensions on both sides of the gear disk, consistent with the front/rear and 3/4 face construction.

positive_observations: Eight chunky teeth are readable in front and rear; major silhouette and bore are clear.
Blue-gray body and silver machined surfaces fit the established art language.
Gear is recognizably a component token, with no stray tray or unrelated props.

retest_required: Fresh actual-pixel inspection and exact SHA256 for each repaired candidate. Preserve these source attempts and this raw record.
